description: Creates a one-page chronic pain summary for a doctor, GP or physio appointment (main concern, pain scores, locations, what helps or worsens, medications, daily impact, questions to ask) and a downloadable PDF. Only include details the user has explicitly shared. The PDF is stored temporarily and deleted after 24 hours.

duration.description: How long the pain has been going on

goals.description: What the user hopes to get from the visit

impact_on_daily_life.description: Effect on work, sleep, mood, activities

medications.description: Current medications or treatments the user mentions

name: create_doctor_visit_summary
title: Create doctor visit summary
